item.title: Lewis joins ballot as three Augusta incumbents remain unchallenged
item.description: Only one candidate qualified Thursday in local nonpartisan races, leaving three incumbent commissioners without opposition so far in the May 19 election. The post Lewis joins ballot as three Augusta incumbents remain unchallenged appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta murder suspect wanted in deadly fence dispute now in custody
item.description: A man wanted in connection with a fatal shooting earlier this year on Susan Circle has now been arrested and returned to Richmond County. The post Augusta murder suspect wanted in deadly fence dispute now in custody appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Former commissioner Mason qualifies to reclaim seat
item.description: Former Commissioner Alvin Mason, who resigned last year after an extended absence, qualified this morning to run again for Commission District 4. The post Former commissioner Mason qualifies to reclaim seat appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Guilty on all counts: Jury ends years-long case over Janell’s disappearance
item.description: A Richmond County jury on Friday found Tanya Tripp and Leon Tripp guilty on all counts in the murder of 16-year-old Latania “Janell” Carwell, bringing an end to a case that stretched nearly nine years. Carwell was last seen alive in April 2017 after leaving with her stepfather.
